_comment_zh: 一般不用改。素材可用节点上的「⤓ 下载素材」按钮自动下载到 library_dir。若你已有素材库，把 gallery_root 指过去（含 data/、thumbs/、img/ 的那一层）。
_comment_en: Usually nothing to change. Use the '⤓ Download assets' button on any node to fetch assets into library_dir. If you already have a library, point gallery_root at it (the folder containing data/, thumbs/, img/).

_field_notes.gallery_root: 留空自动探测：插件目录 ./、../、以及 library_dir。也可设环境变量 POSE_GALLERY_ROOT。
_field_notes.library_dir: 一键下载的目标目录。留空 = 用户目录下的 pose-gallery-library。也可设环境变量 POSE_GALLERY_LIBRARY。

_note: This repo ships NO asset data. The downloader fetches assets from the original author's site to YOUR machine; it does not redistribute them. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
